title: OrganizerBillDocument
description: Catch's bill to one organizer for one billing period, made from the bookings paid into the organizer's own account (hostCollected). Since the move to rolling cycles (#1126) a period is one commission cycle: commission.cycleDays days, anchored at the end of the organizer's free trial, billed in arrears when it closes, with the cap applied per cycle. Bills made before then are calendar months, India time (periodKind absent or calendarMonth); cycle bills never count a payment captured before the end of the organizer's last calendar-month bill or 1 November 2026, India time. A cycle is billed for tools-only OR ticketing, never both: a tools-only cycle bills the flat tools-only fee and no commission. Commission uses each payment's frozen terms (or the organizer's current terms when a payment has none), the free trial, and the cap from the organizer's current terms. GST is added only while Settings → Payments says Catch is GST registered. A host's first two billing cycles wait for staff to review and send them; later cycle bills are sent automatically unless held (autoSendAtMillis, sendHold). A refund recorded after a cycle bill was sent or paid is credited on the organizer's next cycle bill (refundCredit), never making a bill negative. An invoice number is taken from the financial year's unbroken sequence when the bill is sent. Server-only; Admin reads and acts on it through adminManageOrganizerBills.
x-owner: Functions organizer billing (daily cycle generation, adminManageOrganizerBills, Razorpay payment link webhook)

status.description: toSend: made, not sent. sent: sent with its invoice number and due date; overdue is sent past its due date. paid, writtenOff: closed. free: nothing due because every sale fell in the free trial, or because refund credit from earlier bills covered it.

sendHold.description: A staff hold on sending a bill or an organizer's bills automatically, with who placed it and why.

billId.description: organizerId_YYYY-MM for a calendar-month bill; organizerId_cYYYY-MM-DD (the cycle's first day, India time) for a cycle bill.

month.description: The calendar month billed, or for a cycle bill the India-time month its cycle ends in, which Admin's monthly view groups by.

periodKind.description: calendarMonth for bills made before rolling cycles; cycle afterwards. Absent means calendarMonth.

cycleNumber.description: The cycle's position after the trial, from 1. Cycle bills only.

countFromMillis.description: Payments captured from here to periodEndMillis are billed: the cycle start, or later for the cycle that straddles the move from calendar-month bills. Cycle bills only.

plan.description: What the cycle was billed on. ticketing: commission on sales. toolsOnly: the flat tools-only fee and no commission. Absent means ticketing.

autoSendAtMillis.description: Cycle bills only: when the daily run issues and sends this bill without staff, or null when staff must review and send it. Until staff have sent two of a host's cycle bills (free bills and bills prepaid by a tools-only purchase are never sent and do not count), every cycle bill waits for staff; from then on a new cycle bill is sent automatically about a day after it is made, unless it or its organizer is on hold. Absent (bills made before automatic sending) means null.

sendHold.description: A staff hold on sending this bill automatically; null or absent when not held. Staff can still send a held bill themselves.

baseMinor.description: What commission is charged on: gross or net of refunds, per the terms.

providerFeeMinor.description: Razorpay's fees on these sales, taken from the organizer's account; shown for their records.

unsnapshottedCount.description: Payments that froze no terms and were charged on the organizer's current terms.

rateBasisPoints.description: The organizer's current rate; individual payments may have frozen another.

totalMinor.description: What the organizer owes: the commission (or tools-only fee) less refundCredit.appliedMinor, plus GST on the rest.

refundCredit.description: Cycle bills only: commission Catch owes back because refunds were recorded after earlier cycle bills of this organizer were sent or paid (owner, 9 Nov 2026). Each earlier ticketing bill is recomputed with today's refunds, its own frozen rates, trial and per-cycle cap; what the refunds take off its commission, less what other bills already took, is the credit. It comes off this bill before GST, never below zero, and what is left carries forward to the next bill. Tools-only cycles bill a flat fee and owe no credit. Null or absent when nothing is owed.

availableMinor.description: Credit owed when this bill was made.

appliedMinor.description: Taken off this bill, before GST.

billId.description: The earlier bill whose sales were refunded.

refundedMinor.description: Refunds recorded on its sales since it was made.

creditMinor.description: Its credit still owed when this bill was made.

appliedMinor.description: The part of it taken off this bill.

razorpayInvoice.description: The Razorpay invoice (a numbered invoice document with its own hosted page) on Catch's account that the host pays from. Bills sent before invoices carry paymentLink instead. Absent until created.

paidVia.description: planPurchase: the tools-only purchase prepaid this cycle. invoice: paid from its Razorpay invoice.
